**使用服务端模式时，客户端为可选（默认情况下需要客户端）**
**始终需要服务端支持** Adventure Bags（冒险宝袋）是一款完全可自定义的战利品袋模组，让您能够轻松为整合包生成战利品，或者仅仅想为您的世界增添更多 loot。只需右键点击即可收获满满，满足您内心的“战利品狂热者”渴望。 ### 核心功能 - 4种稀有度等级 - 可调整各冒险宝袋在箱子中的生成概率 - 自由添加或移除宝袋内的战利品 - 支持静态与随机数量，兼容NBT/组件格式 - 轻松添加或移除其他战利品表（Loot-tables） - 可制作升级至更高等级（仅限完整功能模式） - 支持纯服务端运行，兼容原版客户端 ### 服务端功能工作原理 原理相当简单：如果配置设置为启动时加载为服务端模式，该模组将不会加载新物品（这通常会阻止原版客户端加入），而是仅使用原版物品（可配置），默认情况下为4种不同的染料。这些物品会被添加到战利品表中，替代原本的冒险宝袋，但会附带自定义模型数据（Custom Model Data）和自定义名称。当玩家使用这些物品时，模组会检查这些数据以确保它是真正的宝袋而非普通物品。因此，通过利用原版函数且不添加新数据，该模组可以完全在服务端运行。
内置战利品表
普通冒险宝袋 ``` "2-16 minecraft:moss_block", "16 minecraft:torch", "minecraft:chest", "1-8 minecraft:emerald", "1-16 minecraft:coal", "6-16 minecraft:arrow", "1-4 minecraft:amethyst_shard", "1-6 minecraft:raw_iron", "1-6 minecraft:raw_copper", "1-4 minecraft:raw_gold", "minecraft:iron_shovel", "minecraft:iron_helmet", "minecraft:iron_boots", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_porkchop", "minecraft:bucket", "16 minecraft:clay", "12 minecraft:feather", "6 minecraft:gunpowder", "4-8 minecraft:bread", "16 minecraft:string", "6 minecraft:leather", "2 minecraft:book", "2-4 minecraft:bone", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_cod", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_salmon", "2-6 minecraft:ink_sac", "1-4 minecraft:cocoa_beans", "minecraft:cake", "4-16 minecraft:cookie", "4-16 minecraft:melon_slice", "2-12 minecraft:dried_kelp", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_beef", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_chicken", "1-4 minecraft:experience_bottle", "4-8 minecraft:baked_potato", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_rabbit", "minecraft:iron_horse_armor", "minecraft:name_tag", "minecraft:lead", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_mutton" ```

史诗冒险宝袋 ``` "minecraft:lapis_block", "1-2 minecraft:diamond", "minecraft:diamond_helmet", "minecraft:diamond_boots", "minecraft:diamond_axe", "minecraft:diamond_shovel", "minecraft:diamond_hoe", "minecraft:enchanted_golden_apple", "minecraft:blaze_spawn_egg", "minecraft:cave_spider_spawn_egg", "minecraft:creeper_spawn_egg", "minecraft:drowned_spawn_egg", "minecraft:enderman_spawn_egg", "minecraft:endermite_spawn_egg", "minecraft:skeleton_spawn_egg", "minecraft:witch_spawn_egg", "minecraft:wither_skeleton_spawn_egg", "minecraft:zombie_spawn_egg", "minecraft:dragon_head", "minecraft:diamond_horse_armor", "minecraft:heart_of_the_sea", "1-3 minecraft:echo_shard", "1-3 minecraft:frogspawn", "1-6 minecraft:coal_ore", "minecraft:diamond_ore", "1-4 minecraft:redstone_ore", "1-6 minecraft:gold_ore", "1-8 minecraft:iron_ore", "1-4 minecraft:lapis_ore", "1-4 minecraft:emerald_ore" ```
传说冒险宝袋 ``` "minecraft:spawner", "1-3 minecraft:netherite_scrap", "minecraft:diamond_sword", "minecraft:diamond_pickaxe", "minecraft:diamond_chestplate", "minecraft:diamond_leggings", "minecraft:skeleton_skull", "minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull", "minecraft:player_head", "minecraft:zombie_head", "minecraft:creeper_head", "minecraft:piglin_head", "minecraft:nether_star", "minecraft:end_crystal", "minecraft:dragon_breath", "minecraft:trident", "minecraft:totem_of_undying", "minecraft:budding_amethyst", "minecraft:dragon_egg", "minecraft:diamond_block", "1-3 minecraft:iron_block", "1-2 minecraft:gold_block", "minecraft:netherite_ingot" ```
配置设置 配置过程相当简单。如果您仅游玩原版，通常无需过多操作。直接使用默认设置即可确保启用上述内置战利品表。 然而，如果您正在制作整合包，可能希望自定义配置以包含其他模组的物品。这同样很简单。您可以使用模组菜单集成（推荐）或直接编辑配置文件。若要将新物品添加到宝袋战利品表中，您需要知道其命名空间（Namespace）和物品ID，例如 `"minecraft:diamond_block"` 代表原版的钻石块。 #### 宝袋战利品表 宝袋战利品表支持以下格式：`(最小数量)-(最大数量) [命名空间:物品ID](组件数据)`。其中括号 `()` 内的内容为可选，方括号 `[]` 为必填（数量和组件可选，物品ID必填）。
v2.0.0 及以上版本使用自定义数据处理方式。您可以使用此[网站](https://a5ho9999.github.io/AdventureBagsTool/)
v2.0.0 以下版本需使用 1.20.4 的 NBT 格式，推荐使用 [McStacker](https://mcstacker.net/1.20.3.php)。网站上的 `/give` 选项可生成正确数据。直接从输出中复制即可（仅复制物品后的 NBT 数据。复制整个输出会导致无效条目）
#### 示例： - `minecraft:diamond_block` - 单个钻石块 - `3 minecraft:diamond_block` - 3个钻石块 - `1-8 minecraft:diamond_block` - 随机生成 1 到 8 个钻石块（含1和8） - (v2.0.0+) `minecraft:diamond_sword{"name":"Shiny Blue Thing"}` - 一个名为“闪亮的蓝色玩意儿”的钻石块 - `minecraft:diamond_block{display:{Name:'{"text":"Shiny Blue Thing"}'}}` - 一个名为“闪亮的蓝色玩意儿”的钻石块 #### 生成战利品表 为宝袋指定生成位置（包含或排除战利品表）也非常简单。只需将战利品表路径加入列表即可。战利品表必须位于 `data/[命名空间]/loot_table/` 文件夹内。例如 `chests/simple_dungeon` 对应文件路径为 `data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/simple_dungeon.json`。此方法同样适用于任何模组的战利品表（不仅限于 chests 文件夹）。 #### 宝袋生成概率 您可以通过设置 1.0 到 0.0（最低 0.00001）之间的数值来调整宝袋在战利品表中的生成稀有度。1.0 代表 100%，0.0 代表几乎不生成（或在不将其从列表中完全移除的情况下尽可能接近 0）。默认值分别为：普通 0.8（80%）、稀有 0.4（40%）、史诗 0.15（15%）、传说 0.08（8%）。 #### 服务端选项 大部分内容上文已说明，此处逻辑也很直接。切换至“仅服务端模式”将阻止模组加载原版之外的任何自定义/额外数据，从而避免注册表冲突。它将使用下方选项中指定的物品作为冒险宝袋，并通过自定义名称和模型数据确保其与默认原版物品区分开来。如果提供的物品无效，系统将默认回退至彩色染料。 *如果输入错误，游戏仍能正常运行。系统仅会在日志中打印无效输入的报错信息。因此若您未获得预期结果，请务必查看日志。您可在配置文件中开启调试模式（需手动将文件中的值设为 true）以获取更多信息*
配置示例 示例配置文件位于 `config/adventure-loot.json5` ```json { "Debug": false, "DefaultOptions": "Disabled", "CommonChance": 0.8, "RareChance": 0.4, "EpicChance": 0.15, "LegendaryChance": 0.08, "CommonLoot": [ "minecraft:moss_block", "12 minecraft:diamond", "4-9 minecraft:gold_ingot ", "minecraft:diamond_chestplate{display:{Name:'{\"text\":\"fancy chestplate\"}'},Enchantments:[{id:\"minecraft:protection\",lvl:69s}]}", "minecraft:chest{BlockEntityTag:{Items:[{Slot:13b,id:\"minecraft:cake\",Count:1b,tag:{display:{Name:'{\"text\":\"Hoef\\'s Favourite\",\"color\":\"white\",\"bold\":true}',Lore:['{\"text\":\"Just a little squashed\",\"color\":\"light_purple\",\"italic\":true}']}}}],Lock:\"Flight Licence\"}}" ], "RareLoot": [ "40 minecraft:iron_ingot" ], "EpicLoot": [ "9-64 minecraft:diamond" ], "LegendaryLoot": [ "minecraft:diamond_chestplate" ], "TablesToExclude": [ "chests/simple_dungeon", "chests/village/village_mason" ], "TablesToAdd": [ "entities/cow" ], "ServerSideOnly": false, "ServerSideCommonItem": "minecraft:white_dye", "ServerSideRareItem": "minecraft:blue_dye", "ServerSideEpicItem": "minecraft:red_dye", "ServerSideLegendaryItem": "minecraft:purple_dye" } ```
*欢迎在整合包中使用本模组，但请保持下载链接位于 Modrinth 生态内，切勿重新上传或二次发布*
